Procedure: Repair of the fault of the signal not appearing

sections_en.text: This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the safety-oil presence indicating lamp of the turbine not appearing.

The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and the company coordinator for the

This fault is worked on while the unit is out of service, because working on the switch for the turbine safety-oil presence indicating lamp signal (PS), located on the main stop valve, causes tripping of the unit's 132 kV circuit breaker.

Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department; the procedures are carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work permit approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel whose names are mentioned in the work permit

rows: Look in the turbine file, Turbine control supervising (204)a, Chapter 5, Turbine Protection, page Max60a, where it is shown that there are two switches on the main stop valve: switch No. (a3325A) on the right-hand main stop valve and the other, No. (a3325B), on the main stop valve left; they are responsible for lighting the P2 priming indicating lamp
Enter the addresses of the two switches on the computer, (B328) and (BF28); it was found that there is an error in the output signal of the BF28 address
Simulate this address, (BF28), and the lamp lit

Upon removing the cover on the main stop valve left, a problem was found in the switch on it: its normal position, with safety oil present, is open on its terminals (110 V DC), but it was found closed
Check that the switch repair is complete and that it is working normally
Re-prime the oil and check that the indicating lamp appears and the fault is repaired

Egyptian Electricity Holding Company
Maintenance Procedures Information System
Maintenance Procedures Information System
 | Instrumentation and Control | Maintenance Procedures
Document No.: MI-003-r0a | Equipment: Control circuit of the turbine safety-oil presence signal, PS, on the thermal disk, ABB
Issued to: Assiut 3, 30 MW
Status: Approved
Approval date: 26 March 2007 | Procedure: Repair of the fault of the signal not appearing
Next review date: March 2012
Introduction
This document sets out the steps for repairing the fault of the safety-oil presence indicating lamp of the turbine not appearing.
The document was prepared by Eng. Ayman Mohamed Abdel Magid, reviewed and tested by Eng. Magdy Mahrous Shehata, approved by Eng. Abdel Azim Gomaa Hagras, General Manager of Assiut Thermal, and approved by Mr. Eng. Hussein Ahmed El-Mahdy, Head of Sector, and certified by Mr. Eng. Gamal El-Din Abdel Wahab, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector and the company coordinator for the
Safety Precautions
This fault is worked on while the unit is out of service, because working on the switch for the turbine safety-oil presence indicating lamp signal (PS), located on the main stop valve, causes tripping of the unit's 132 kV circuit breaker.
Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department; the procedures are carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work permit approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel whose names are mentioned in the work permit
This fault is worked on while the unit is out of service, because working on the switch for the turbine safety-oil presence indicating lamp signal (PS), located on the main stop valve, causes tripping of the unit's 132 kV circuit breaker.
Issue a work permit approved by the station Operations Department; the procedures are carried out under the supervision of the maintenance engineer executing the work permit approved by the Head of the Instrument Maintenance Department
Record the occupational safety and health category of all personnel whose names are mentioned in the work permit
Tools and Equipment Used
Flat screwdriver, 8 inch, pliers, 7 inch
Flat screwdriver, 4 inch, Allen key, 6 inch
Avometer for measurement
Flat screwdriver, 8 inch, pliers, 7 inch
Flat screwdriver, 4 inch, Allen key, 6 inch
Avometer for measurement
Procedures to be Carried Out
Open the work permit | 1.
Look in the turbine file, Turbine control supervising (204)a, Chapter 5, Turbine Protection, page Max60a, where it is shown that there are two switches on the main stop valve: switch No. (a3325A) on the right-hand main stop valve and the other, No. (a3325B), on the main stop valve left; they are responsible for lighting the P2 priming indicating lamp | 2.
Enter the addresses of the two switches on the computer, (B328) and (BF28); it was found that there is an error in the output signal of the BF28 address | 3.
Simulate this address, (BF28), and the lamp lit | 4.
Upon removing the cover on the main stop valve left, a problem was found in the switch on it: its normal position, with safety oil present, is open on its terminals (110 V DC), but it was found closed | 5.
Check that the switch repair is complete and that it is working normally | 6.
Re-prime the oil and check that the indicating lamp appears and the fault is repaired | 7.
